title: Bandhan Bank ties up with Bajaj Allianz Life for bancassurance
body: Bandhan Bank has signed a bancassurance agreement with Bajaj Allianz Life Insurance Company to distribute the insurer's life products across its 1,700 branches from July 2026. The bank already distributes products for HDFC Life Insurance under an arrangement signed in 2021, and its earlier tie-up with Aegon Life ended in 2024. The agreement does not involve any equity investment by either party.
